page: <meta charset="utf-8"><title>Gate B</title><script>window.runToggle = request => new Promise(resolve => {const progress=[]; const worker = new Worker('/worker.mjs', {type:'module'}); const timer = setTimeout(() => {worker.terminate(); resolve({timeout:true,deadlineMs:request.deadlineMs??45000,progress});}, request.deadlineMs??45000); worker.onmessage = ({data}) => {if(data.done) {clearTimeout(timer); worker.terminate(); resolve({...data,progress});} else progress.push(data);}; worker.onerror = e => {clearTimeout(timer); worker.terminate(); resolve({error:e.message,progress});}; worker.postMessage(request); });</script>
